## About
Richie and Rich Lawson founded Superior Import Repair for people who love their Subarus as much as they do. Rich is the lead mechanic and shop foreman. Richie is the shop manager and service writer, and he's been buying, selling and working on Subarus since he was a teenager. When things get especially crazy, his wife Lisa helps out in the office.
Our Burnside shop works on Subarus only. We're an independent shop, not affiliated with Subaru of America, and we're never too busy to answer your questions or give you advice about your car.
Customers have given us a 4.7 rating from 145 Google reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes for your Subaru.
- Factory recommended services: Scheduled maintenance done the way Subaru recommends.
- Engine repairs: From small fixes to big jobs. One reviewer brought in a Turbo Baja and Rich and his team rebuilt the engine.
- Pre-Purchase Inspection: Thinking about buying a Subaru? Have us look it over first so you know what you're getting.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: Yes, please. Give us a call to set up a time.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8 am to 5 pm. We're closed on weekends.

Q: What kind of parts do you use?
A: You have choices. We offer Genuine Subaru Parts, OEM, used and performance parts for our repairs.
